text:
sam: Quick sync: EdgeBoard partner wants a micro-bench next week to compare perf/W and throughput for our 4k streaming profile. Narrow scope: three fan profiles, two kernel variants, power caps. Ivy can coordinate lab time.
ivy: We have one rack Tue/Wed. Need Redwood container by Mon EOD and kernel hashes. Also please confirm telemetry fields.
taylor: I'll handle the container and a deterministic seed set of 25 prompts for regression. Will push to /bench/inputs/edge-seed-2025-04-01.json.
edge-fw: Kernel variants: baseline and memcopy-async. We'll provide commits and a small firmware toggle. Note: memcopy-async may require fan=max on older chassis for stability.
sam: For telemetry collect per_gpu.power_w, p95_latency_ms, tokens_per_sec, kernel_step_ms, kv_cache_hit, and chassis_vrm_c. JSONL preferred.
benchbot: FYI benchbot expects files named `edgeboard-*.jsonl` in /bench/artifacts and will auto-ingest.
ivy: Canary plan: single chassis per kernel variant + fan profile before full rack. If stable, proceed.
taylor: I'll add retries=2 and --capture-traces to harness and tag flaky runs. Also --out /bench/artifacts/edgeboard-$RUN.jsonl.
sam: Post-run deliverables: raw JSONL, benchbot summary, perf/W plots, and a short joint notes doc. NDA: partner-private until both legal teams approve.
edge-fw: Agreed. We'll lock down publication until legal signoff.
ivy: Scheduling: I'll create calendar invites and a short checklist PR. 08:30 call for handoff on Tue.
taylor: Pushing container Monday EOD.
sam: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
